characters.Kai: src/anim/cast.py KAI - lucky red Hawaiian shirt, shorts, flip-flops; works at the boardwalk surf shop
characters.Tess: 15, customer, dark ponytail, yellow hoodie, brave but scared, has never surfed
characters.The infected: grey-green skin, torn clothes, white eyes, slow then fast; they will not go into water

scenes.narration: ~Paddle out? There are forty infected on the boardwalk. They are clawing at the glass of Kai's surf shop. And the only way out... is the ocean.
scenes.visual: infected hands on the shop glass, the sea behind, PADDLE OUT?

scenes.narration: Six in the morning. Kai unlocked the surf shop like he did every day. Sun coming up. Waves perfect.
scenes.visual: Kai unlocking the shop door at sunrise, happy

scenes.narration: Could be worse, he said, looking at the rain clouds. It was about to get much worse.
scenes.visual: Kai smiling, grey clouds rolling in

scenes.narration: At six fifteen, the screaming started.
A girl ran through his door. Fifteen. Yellow hoodie. Blood on her sleeve that wasn't hers.
scenes.visual: Tess bursts into the shop, terrified

scenes.narration: Lock it, she said. Lock it now. They bite.
scenes.visual: Tess close, pointing at the door

scenes.narration: Kai looked outside. A man was walking toward the shop. Grey skin. White eyes. Mouth open.
scenes.visual: infected man walking on the boardwalk, stiff

scenes.narration: Kai locked the door. Then he grabbed every surfboard on the wall and jammed them against the glass.
scenes.visual: Kai stacking surfboards against the door

scenes.narration: By noon there were ten of them outside. By sunset, forty.
scenes.visual: infected crowd growing outside the window, sky going orange

scenes.narration: The power went out. The radio said one thing. Stay indoors. Do not go outside.
But Tess noticed something. The infected came right up to the beach... and stopped at the waves.
scenes.visual: infected lined up at the water's edge, not stepping in

scenes.narration: They won't go in the water, she whispered.

scenes.visual: crack across the shop window, hands pressing

scenes.narration: Kai looked at the back door. At the beach. At the two longboards by the counter.
scenes.visual: Kai looking from the door to the boards

scenes.narration: Tess had never surfed in her life. It was dark. And the tide was going out.
scenes.visual: Tess shaking her head, dark ocean outside

scenes.narration: Kai grabbed both boards. Get ready, he said. When I say go... we run for the water.
Paddle out? Tell me in the comments. Part two is up next.
